annotation.authors_or_issuer: Cổng Thông tin điện tử Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ (Vietnam Ministry of Science and Technology)
key_provisions_or_claims: Law classifies AI systems by risk level with corresponding legal obligations
High-risk AI in finance, health, justice, labour and education faces stricter data, testing, monitoring and human intervention requirements
Establishes a National AI Development Fund, AI Voucher scheme and controlled sandbox
Addresses AI-generated content, algorithmic ethics and cross-border AI platform responsibility
Requires a national AI workforce strategy and AI education integration
annotation.summary_en: Ministry of Science and Technology news item reporting the National Assembly's passage of Vietnam's AI Law in December 2025. It outlines risk-based classification, obligations for high-risk AI, a national AI fund, AI vouchers, sandboxes, AI-generated content rules and workforce development, balancing innovation with risk control.
